title: Claude Code Getting Started: Complete Setup Guide (2026)
summary: Get Claude Code running in under 10 minutes. Install on Mac, Windows, or Linux, authenticate, create CLAUDE.md, and run your first agentic coding session.
body_markdown:
**Option A: Native Windows (PowerShell)**


Open PowerShell and run:


```text
irm https:  //  claude.ai  /  install.ps1   |   iex
```


**Option B: WSL2 (Recommended for Best Experience)**


WSL2 gives you a full Linux environment inside Windows. File-watching and shell integrations work more reliably there:


1. Open PowerShell as Administrator:` wsl --install`
2. Restart when prompted
3. Open Ubuntu from Start, set up your username and password
4. Inside WSL2:` curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash`


WSL2 is the recommended Windows path. If you already develop in WSL2, run Claude Code there. If you're a pure Windows developer, the PowerShell installer works for most tasks.
